_doc: Minimal positives for the wording rules: each stem must trigger its rule.
Only wording rules live here. Structural violations (codes, option counts,
construct sizes, ordering) are built in tests/test_survey_validator.py with
the make_survey helper, because their interesting content is shape rather
than natural language and a JSON file would obscure it.
See hard_negatives.json for the matching negatives of double_barreled.

double_barreled.why: Both items are evaluation targets; a respondent could be happy with quality and unhappy with speed.

stem.zh-CN: 您对本店的服务质量和配送速度是否满意？
stem.en: Are you satisfied with the service quality and the delivery speed?

double_barreled.why: Appearance and after-sales support are independent attributes with no necessary correlation.

stem.zh-CN: 这款产品的外观和售后是否达到您的预期？
stem.en: Did the design and the support meet your expectations?

double_barreled.why: Content and delivery format are separate evaluation dimensions: the content can be good while the format is poor.

stem.zh-CN: 您认为课程的内容和方式安排合理吗？
stem.en: Do you find the course content and the delivery design reasonable?

leading_question.why: Presupposes the service is excellent before asking.

stem.zh-CN: 您对我们优秀的客服服务有多满意？
stem.en: How satisfied are you with our excellent support service?

leading_question.why: Rhetorical framing pushes the respondent toward agreement.

stem.zh-CN: 难道不觉得这个价格很划算吗？
stem.en: Don't you agree that this price is a bargain?

double_negative.why: Two negations inside one clause invert the meaning under time pressure.

stem.zh-CN: 您是否不认为这个功能没有帮助？
stem.en: Do you not think this feature is not helpful?

double_negative.why: Same pattern with a different negator pair.

stem.zh-CN: 您不会没有注意到这个变化吧？
stem.en: You would not have failed to notice no change?

absolute_wording.why: An absolute quantifier makes agreement almost impossible.

stem.zh-CN: 本产品总是能满足您的需求吗？
stem.en: Does this product always meet your needs?

absolute_wording.why: "All" forces a single exception to flip the answer.

stem.zh-CN: 所有功能都符合您的预期吗？
stem.en: Do all features meet your expectations?

jargon.why: Domain metric a general respondent will not know.

stem.zh-CN: 您认为本产品的复购率表现如何？
stem.en: How do you rate this product's retention?

stem.zh-CN: 本产品的 API 是否满足您的需要？
stem.en: Does the API meet your needs?

question_length.why: Chinese stem well past the 40-character guideline.

stem.zh-CN: 在您过去半年使用本产品的整个过程当中，综合考虑您在使用前的期待以及使用后的实际感受，您觉得这款产品的整体表现究竟如何呢？

stem.en: Taking into account everything you expected before you started using this product as well as what you actually experienced afterwards, how would you describe the overall performance of it?

fabricated_citation.why: Author-year citation pattern in a generated item.

stem.zh-CN: 本题改编自 (Parasuraman 1988) 的服务质量测量。

fabricated_citation.why: Claims to reproduce a named published instrument.

stem.zh-CN: 以下题目来自 SERVQUAL 标准量表。
stem.en: The following items come from the SERVQUAL instrument.
